name: Intelligent Design
overview: Scripture reveals that the universe and humanity are the intentional creations of God, who formed the heavens and the earth at the beginning (Genesis 1:1) and crafted mankind in His own image (Genesis 1:27). The psalmist reflects on the heavens as the handiwork of God's fingers, demonstrating divine order and design (Psalms 8:3; Psalms 19:1). Job acknowledges God’s intimate role in forming him from clay, emphasizing personal and purposeful creation (Job 10:9). In contrast, Psalm 14:1 warns against denying God’s existence, highlighting the folly of rejecting the evident design and goodness found in His works.
